literal: To everyone, good it is, humility; among them, to the wealthy indeed, wealth's quality it has.
translation: Humility is good for everyone; yet, among them, for the wealthy, it is a wealth that possesses the true nature of wealth.
modern: பணிவுடன் நடப்பது எல்லாருக்கும் நல்லது. ஆனால், அவர்களுள் செல்வந்தர்களுக்கு அந்தப் பணிவே மேலும் ஒரு செல்வமாக விளங்கும் தகைமையைப் பெற்றுள்ளது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the universal value of humility (பணிதல்) while emphasizing its special beauty in those who are prosperous. While being humble is a virtue that benefits anyone, it becomes an extraordinary ornament for the rich (செல்வர்). For those who already possess material abundance, practicing humility is considered a supreme wealth in itself (செல்வம் தகைத்து), as it is rare and commands the highest respect.
